description: A branch partition consults the numeric authorities: the conjunction a true edge asserts is handed to the exact linear backend, and an edge with no model partitions as a single arm. The refuted arm withholds its publications and its diagnostics, so the element read it contains produces nothing; the satisfiable twin keeps both arms and still owes the read's obligation, which is what makes the refutation a proof rather than a silenced check. A disjunction states neither of its arms, so mutually exclusive disjuncts leave the arm they guard reachable.
